Name: Enchantment Info
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]With this mod, hold Shift while hovering an enchanted tool or weapon, and the tooltip shows a short description of each enchantment on it. Enchantments that work differently on different tools, like Generous on a hoe or a pan, get the matching description.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]This mod was written with the help of an AI coding assistant. I came up with the idea, decided how it should behave, tested it in-game and reviewed the result.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Hold Shift while hovering an enchanted item to see what each enchantment does.
- Covers all tool enchantments (axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can, pan, fishing rod) and the weapon enchantments from the Forge.
- The key can be changed, controller buttons work too.
- A small reminder line in the tooltip while the key isn't held (can be turned off).
- Settings via Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json: ExpandKey, ShowHint.
- Translations: English, German.
- Open source (MIT): https://github.com/Malenyaaa/stardew-mods[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI (required): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and the mod build tools, and to spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color]
